title: Crown with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="gold" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFA500"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="gemR" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF4466"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#CC1133"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="gemB" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#66BBFF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2277CC"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Crown base band -->
  <rect x="14" y="56" width="72" height="26" rx="6" fill="url(#gold)" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Shading on band -->
  <rect x="14" y="72" width="72" height="10" rx="6" fill="#E09000" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Crown points -->
  <path d="M14 56 L14 30 L26 56 Z" fill="url(#gold)" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M32 56 L38 20 L44 56 Z" fill="url(#gold)" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M50 56 L50 14 L58 56 Z" fill="url(#gold)" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M64 56 L70 22 L76 56 Z" fill="url(#gold)" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M82 56 L86 32 L86 56 Z" fill="url(#gold)" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Gem on left point -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="42" r="5" fill="url(#gemR)" stroke="#FF88AA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Gem on middle-left point -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="32" r="5" fill="url(#gemB)" stroke="#99DDFF" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Gem on center point -->
  <circle cx="52" cy="26" r="6" fill="url(#gemR)" stroke="#FF88AA" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- Gem on middle-right point -->
  <circle cx="68" cy="34" r="5" fill="url(#gemB)" stroke="#99DDFF" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Gem on right point -->
  <circle cx="83" cy="44" r="4.5" fill="url(#gemR)" stroke="#FF88AA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Smiling face on crown band -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="66" rx="4" ry="4.5" fill="#3D1A00" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="66" rx="4" ry="4.5" fill="#3D1A00" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="39.5" cy="64.5" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="63.5" cy="64.5" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M40 73 Q50 81 60 73" fill="none" stroke="#3D1A00" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="72" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#FF6644" opacity="0.45"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="72" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#FF6644" opacity="0.45"/>

  <!-- Bottom decorative band -->
  <rect x="14" y="79" width="72" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#E09000" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Small dots on band -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#FFE44D" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#FFE44D" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#FFE44D" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#FFE44D" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
